help_portal_text: ABpE Portal - Automated Consultant Profile Recording System. Manages CVs, consultants, matching and workflows.
help_nav1: Sidebar: Icons become visible on hover
help_nav3: All sections can be toggled open/closed by clicking
help_nav4: Search at top: Find consultants, CVs and records across the portal
help_lang_header: Language: Buttons top right (DE/EN/ES/IT/FR) or under Settings
help_lang_persist: The selected language is saved and loaded on next login
help_theme_toggle: Light/Dark mode: Sun/Moon button top right or under Settings
help_mod_overview: Each module can have its own help — "Help" button in the module view
help_mod_email: Email Studio: detailed tutorial with simulations (Overview, Modules, Variables, Translation)
help_mod_more: Additional modules (Doc Studio, Matching, CRM) are being added step by step
